text:
The trial court should **sustain the objection and exclude** the deposition testimony. Under FRE 804(b)(1), the company must have had an opportunity and similar motive to cross-examine the engineer on the issue now offered, and in the wrongful-termination suit the issue was retaliatory firing, not whether the safety reports were false or the aircraft defective. My earlier answer, which treated the company's motives as similar, was wrong because it did not separate the issue in the first suit from the issue at trial.

CONFIDENCE: 65
